items.title: M0 profile and red performance baseline
items.context: Measure the current 1,000,000-record runtime memory reference/indexed/warm paths and identify where time is spent, especially token-map scan vs pack build vs cache hit/miss. Produce a failing or unmet-target profile artifact showing the 1-2s hot-path target is not yet proven.

items.title: M1 semantic parity guard
items.context: Lock current exact/fuzzy/superseded/candidate/stale/deprecated/malformed/line-cap behavior behind golden queries and digest parity so optimization cannot silently change memory guidance semantics.

items.title: M2 exact-token fast path
items.context: Replace common query matching with O(1) exact token lookup while preserving fallback behavior and proving 1,000,000-record parity.

items.title: M3 prefix or fuzzy auxiliary index
items.context: Avoid full tokenMap scans for fuzzy/includes behavior by adding an auxiliary prefix/trigram or equivalent bounded fuzzy index, preserving parity and reporting indexed cold/warm latency.

items.title: M4 persistent cache and prebuilt index lifecycle
items.context: Make optimized runtime packs reusable across CLI process boundaries by adding durable cache or prebuilt index lifecycle with strict source/config/policy/indexVersion binding and stale handling.

items.title: M5 performance gate and benchmark report
items.context: Add a benchmark/report gate that records p50/p95 or equivalent repeated-query latency for reference, indexed cold, and warm/cache paths, keeping false performance claims blocked until thresholds are actually met.

items.title: M6 rollout docs validation and version bump
items.context: Document the completed performance path, keep runtime memory non-authoritative and gateEvidence=false, run build, parity smokes, full 1,000,000 benchmark, review assurance, DONE, and CLI patch version bump.
